_about: Boeing MD-11 Airport Planning (Rev E), 2.2: page index 13, layers.py --mode image --unrotate --rotate 180 at scale 4, clip 140,130,520,280 (front). Pixels of that raster, line centres; the right half as drawn (the aircraft's left side). The front view's fuselage circle is drawn 5% larger than the printed 6.02 m (the span, engines and nacelles are to the side view's scale): crownTop is its centre less the printed radius.
